title: "Usage: republish in_transport in:=<in_base_topic> [out_transport] out:=<out_base_topic>" in ROS 2 image_transport: compressed to raw on Humble, Jazzy and Lyrical, positional args vs parameters, in/compressed remaps and the missing plugin, measured
excerpt: Why Humble's republish prints a Usage line for -p in_transport, why Jazzy and Lyrical silently ignore compressed raw, which remaps deliver images, the TransportLoadException when the plugin is missing, and a launch file that worked on all three. Measured on Humble, Jazzy and Lyrical.
